about: Close-ups of the problems the 2026-10-25 audit found (docs/AUDIT-2026-10-25.md on the code team's branch; evidence shots in docs/screenshots/audit-2026-10-25/), on the audit's own cameras: target on the ground, offset converted to distance, azimuth and elevation. Film each era with --site like shots/eras.json. AD 54, mid-morning.
